subject: Aligning a rotating demo cadence — APAC/EU/US overlap windows
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning a rotating demo cadence — APAC/EU/US overlap windows

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To make sure we get the right stakeholders (AE + SE + your engineering + procurement/security) involved without late-night calls for any one group, I want to propose a short rotating demo cadence so different regions get a friendly window.

High-level ask: can you confirm which of these windows your team can join and whether procurement/security will need a separate slot for the contract/SSO discussion?

Proposed 45-minute hands-on demo (30m demo + 15m Q&A / procurement):
- Option A (APAC-friendly): 2028-11-29 10:00 SGT / 03:00 UTC / 22:00 PST (Nov 28)
- Option B (EU-friendly): 2028-11-30 10:00 CET / 09:00 UTC / 01:00 PST
- Option C (US-friendly): 2028-12-01 10:30 PST / 18:30 UTC / 19:30 CET

Notes:
- Alex (SE) requests a 20-minute pre-call to validate the test account and access (we can do that 30 minutes before the demo).
- I attached a lightweight timezone-grid.csv and a draft mutual-action-plan.pdf to help with scheduling and tasks.
- If none of the above work, tell us two 1-hour windows that do and we’ll rotate the team accordingly.

Quick next steps:
1) Reply with preferred option(s) and attendees (engineering / procurement / security).
2) If procurement needs SSO or a vendor questionnaire, attach it and we’ll loop in Product Security.

Thanks — happy to adapt the cadence to what’s least painful for your crew.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf, timezone-grid.csv
From: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@cloudnova.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudnova.com, security@cloudnova.com
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 23:12:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Aligning a rotating demo cadence — APAC/EU/US overlap windows

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the options. High level: engineering can join APAC/EU slots but procurement/security prefer later in the day Singapore-time (so earlier UTC). A couple constraints:
- Procurement needs to review pricing and will want someone from Redwood Pricing or AE to be present.
- Security has an internal vendor questionnaire (I attached a draft in this reply) and will want 20–30 minutes with your Product Security or Solutions Architect during the call.

Preferred windows from our side:
1) 2028-11-30 09:30–10:15 CET (works for EU engineering + security)
2) 2028-12-01 17:00 SGT / 09:00 UTC (possible if your team can do a later APAC slot)

If neither is workable, we can do Option A but only if Alex can do the pre-check earlier in the day.

Olivia
Director, Cloud Engineering | CloudNova
olivia.tan@cloudnova.com

Attachment: cloudnova_security_questions.xlsx
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@cloudnova.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 00:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning a rotating demo cadence — APAC/EU/US overlap windows

Thanks Olivia — useful constraints. Quick notes from the SE side:
- I can do the EU-friendly slot on 2028-11-30 09:30 CET, but I cannot reliably support a midnight UTC slot on short notice.
- For the security questionnaire: if you can share answers inline or as a Drive link ahead of time I’ll pass them to our Product Security for a quick triage — that usually saves 10–15 minutes on the live call.
- Pre-call: I can do a 20-minute technical check 30 minutes before the confirmed demo time (checking test credentials, sample prompt set, and network egress).

If we settle on the EU slot, Sofia — can you invite Redwood Product Security (cc to product-sec@redwood.ai) for the 09:00–09:30 UTC pre-check?

— Alex
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, product-sec@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 01:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning a rotating demo cadence — APAC/EU/US overlap windows

Great — thanks all. Proposed plan based on availability:
- Confirmed primary slot: 2028-11-30 09:30–10:15 CET (09:00–09:30 UTC pre-check with Alex & Product Security).
- Fallback: 2028-12-01 17:00 SGT if anything blocks the EU slot.
- For future rotations: we’ll run a 3-day cadence (APAC / EU / US windows) for sandbox testing so your teams in each region have a normal-hour option — I’ll draft the calendar series once this first session is set.

Action items for CloudNova:
- Olivia/procurement: confirm attendees for the EU slot and whether procurement needs a separate contract walk-through (I can bring Pricing).
- Security: if you can fill the attached questionnaire before the pre-check, Product Security can triage quickly.

I’ve created a provisional calendar invite and added a Calendly fallback if anyone needs to swap: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

If this works, I’ll send a formal invite with dial-in links and the pre-check invite for Alex/Product Security.

Cheers —
Sofia

Attachments: timezone-grid.csv, mutual-action-plan.pdf
